d:
Bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badal raha hai. subah aur sham ke samay halki thand mahsus hone lagi hai, jabki dophar men tej dhup ke chalte garmi ka asar bana huaa hai. mausam men ho rahe is badlav ke bich logon ki najren aane vale dinon ke purvanuman par tiki hain. is bich mausam vibhag ne taja buletin jari kar rajy ke alag-alag jilon ke mausam ki sthiti bataee hai. aaie jante hain, mausam vibhag ke anusar bihar ke alag-alag jilon men mausam kaisa rahne vala hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
